scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run client:build && npm run desktop:build
scripts.client:build: npm run build --workspace client && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const contract=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('desktop/renderer-path.contract.json','utf8'));const outputDir=contract.rendererDistDir;fs.rmSync(outputDir,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('client/out',outputDir,{recursive:true});"
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run test --workspace @ai-emotion/contracts && npm run contracts:build && npm run test --workspace @ai-emotion/desktop -- src/__tests__/main/bootstrap.test.ts src/__tests__/ipc/register-ipc.test.ts src/__tests__/runtime/config/app-config-store.test.ts src/__tests__/runtime/providers/provider-service.test.ts && npm run client:build && npm run desktop:build
